resources.string: Gamblock-AI Research reads the URL bar, title, headings, and link text in Chrome and Edge for local classification. On Settings or package-installer pages that display Gamblock-AI, the prototype also reads screen labels to detect attempts to disable or remove the service; without a valid approval window it returns to the previous page and shows a warning. URLs and page text are never sent to the backend.
Allow browser protection and research safeguards?

Gamblock-AI Research uses Accessibility Service in the background to read the URL bar, title, headings, and link text in Chrome and Edge. This data is classified only on your device. When gambling content is detected, the app navigates Back and shows a Pattern Interrupt.
On Settings or package-installer pages that display Gamblock-AI, the prototype also reads screen labels to detect attempts to disable, force-stop, or remove the service. Without an active companion approval window, it may return to the previous page and show a warning. This is not an OS guarantee; an administrator still has a recovery path through device administration or installation recovery.
URLs, domains, and page text are never sent to the backend. The backend can receive only aggregate protection counts according to your sharing choices.
